title: The wicked Manthara
introduction: Manthara feels very sad after hearing about anointment of Rama for the princely kingdom. She tells Kaikeyi about the coronation of Rama. Kaikeyi becomes delighted and gives Manthara one of her jewels.
closing: || इत्यार्षे स्रीमद्रामायने आदिकाव्ये अयोध्यकान्दे शस्तः सर्गः ||
Thus completes 7th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञातिदासी यतो जाता कैकेय्या तु सहोषिता |
प्रासादं चन्द्रसङ्काशमारुरोह यदृच्छया
verses.iast:
GYAtidAsI yato jAtA kaikeyyA tu sahoṣitA |
prAsAdaṃ candrasañkAśamAruroha yadṛcchayA
verses.translation: Manthara, a housemaid who was residing with Kaikeyi since her birth, accidentally ascended the balcony of Kaikeyi's white palace, which resembled the full moon.

verses.devanagari:
सिक्तराजपथां कृत्स्नां प्रकीर्णकुसुमोत्कराम् |
अयोध्यां मन्थरा तस्मात्प्रासादादन्ववैक्षत
verses.iast:
siktarAjapathAṃ kṛtsnAṃ prakIrṇakusumotkarAm |
ayodhyAṃ mantharA tasmAtprAsAdAdanvavaikṣata
verses.translation: Manthara, from that balcony, saw the entire city of Ayodhya, with all its principal roads being sprinkled with water and strewn with heaps of flowers.

glosses.meaning: the principal roads being sprinkled with water
and stewn with heaps of flowers.

verses.devanagari:
पताकाभिर्वरार्हाभिर्ध्वजैश्च समलङ्कृताम् |
वृतां चंदपथैश्चापि शिरःस्नातजनैर्वृताम्
माल्यमोदकहस्तैश्च द्विजेन्द्रैरभिनादिताम् |
शुक्लदेवगृहद्वारां सर्ववादित्रनिस्वनाम्
संप्रहृष्टजनाकीर्णां ब्रह्मघोषाभिनादिताम् |
प्रहृष्टवरहस्त्यश्वां संप्रणर्धितगोवृशाम्
प्रहृउष्टमुदितैः पौरैरुच्च्रि तद्वजमालिनीम् |
अयोध्यां वन्थरा तस्मात्प्रासादादन्ववैक्षत
verses.iast:
patAkAbhirvarArhAbhirdhvajaiśca samalañkṛtAm |
vṛtAṃ candapathaiścāpi śiraḥsnAtajanairvṛtAm
mālyamodakahastaiśca dvijendrairabhināditām |
śukladevagṛhadvārāṃ sarvavāditranisvanām
samprahṛśhṭajanākīrṇāṃ brahmaghośhābhināditām |
prahṛśhṭavarahastyaśvāṃ sampraṇardhitagovṛśām
prahṛuśhṭamuditaiḥ paurairuccri tadvajamālinīm |
ayodhyāṃ vantharā tasmātprāsādādanvavaikśata
verses.translation: Manthara further saw from that balcony the city decorated with the best of flags and banners. The roads were cleared for uninterrupted traffic. All the people took head-bath. Brahmans with flowers and sweets in their hands were chanting Mantras. The gateways of temples were white washed. There were sounds of all musical instruments. The city was filled with rejoicing people and resounding chant of Vedas. The elephants and horses were also merry. The bulls were making roaring noise. The highly delighted citizens hoisted rows of flags on their housetops.

glosses.meaning: with flowers and sweets in their hands
resonating with sounds from various musical instruments
and decked with rows of tall flags .

verses.devanagari:
प्रहर्षोत्फुल्लनयनां पाण्डुरक्षौमवासिनीम् |
अविदूरे स्थितां दृष्ट्वा धात्रीं पप्रच्छ मन्थरा
verses.iast:
praharśhotphullanayanāṃ pāṇḍurakśaumavāsinīm |
avidūre sthitāṃ dṛśhṭvā dhātrīṃ papraccha mantharā
verses.translation: Manthara asked a house maid with bright pleasing eyes and wearing white silk clothes standing nearby, as follows: -

verses.devanagari:
उत्तमेनाभिसंयुक्ता हर्षेणार्थपरा सती |
राममाता धनं किं नु जनेभ्यः संप्रयच्छति |
verses.iast:
uttamenābhisaṃyuktā harśheṇārthaparā satī |
rāmamātā dhanaṃ kiṃ nu janebhyaḥ samprayacchati |
verses.translation: "Why is Kausalya giving away money to people so delightfully today in charity, eventhough she is badly lured of money?"

glosses.meaning: (though) she is badly lured of money.

verses.devanagari:
अतिमात्रप्रहर्षोऽयं किं जनस्य च शंस मे |
कारयिष्यति किं वापि संप्रहृष्टो महीपतिः
verses.iast:
atimātrapraharśho'yaṃ kiṃ janasya ca śaṃsa me |
kārayiśhyati kiṃ vāpi samprahṛśhṭo mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: "Why are people so happy today? Is the king duly pleased with something, doing any great act? Tell me."

glosses.meaning: getting done any act? shamsa = tell

verses.devanagari:
विदीर्यमाणा हर्षेण धात्री तु परया मुदा |
आचचक्षेऽथ कुब्जायै भूयसीं राघवश्रियम्
verses.iast:
vidīryamāṇā harśheṇa dhātrī tu parayā mudā |
ācacakśe'tha kubjāyai bhūyasīṃ rāghavaśriyam
verses.translation: That housemaid, bursting with joy, told Manthara in a great gladdening tone about the great honor to be conferred upon Rama.

glosses.meaning: about the great honor to be conferred on Rama.

verses.devanagari:
श्वः पुष्येण जितक्रोधं यौवराज्येन राघवम् |
राजा दशरथो राममभिषेचयितानघम्
verses.iast:
śvaḥ puśhyeṇa jitakrodhaṃ yauvarājyena rāghavam |
rājā daśaratho rāmamabhiśhecayitānagham
verses.translation: "Tomorrow on the day of Pushyami star, king Dasaratha is going to anoint the fault-less Rama for the princely kingdom."

glosses.meaning: on the day of Pushyami star
who was born in Raghu clan

verses.devanagari:
धात्र्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कुब्जा क्षिप्रममर्षिता |
कैलासशिखराकारात्प्रासादादवरोहत
verses.iast:
dhātryāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā kubjā kśipramamarśhitā |
kailāsaśikharākārātprāsādādavarohata
verses.translation: After hearing the words of that maid, Manthara quickly with wrath walked down from the roof of the palace, which was in the shape of mount Kailasa.

verses.devanagari:
सा दह्यमाना कोपेन मनथरा पापदर्शिनी |
शयनामेत्य कैकेयीमिदं वचन मब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sā dahyamānā kopena manatharā pāpadarśinī |
śayanāmetya kaikeyīmidaṃ vacana mabravīt
verses.translation: Manthara of sinful thought; burning with anger, approached Kaikeyi who was lying on a bed and spoke these words:

verses.devanagari:
उत्तिष्ठ मूढे किं शेषे भयं त्वामभिवर्तते |
उपप्लुतमघौघेन किमात्मानं न बुध्यसे
verses.iast:
uttiśhṭha mūḍhe kiṃ śeśhe bhayaṃ tvāmabhivartate |
upaplutamaghaughena kimātmānaṃ na budhyase
verses.translation: "O, fool! Get up. Why are you sleeping? A dreadful situation is befalling you. A flood of troubles submerges you. Why are you not knowing this yourself?"

verses.devanagari:
अनिष्टे सुभगाकारे सौभग्येन विकत्थसे |
चलं हि तव सौभाग्यं नद्याः स्रोत इवोष्णगे
verses.iast:
aniśhṭe subhagākāre saubhagyena vikatthase |
calaṃ hi tava saubhāgyaṃ nadyāḥ srota ivośhṇage
verses.translation: "Oh, Kaikeyi ! You appear to be a beloved wife for your husband, but in reality he does not like you. You boast of your fortune. Like the flow of a stream in summer; your fortune is unsteady".

glosses.itrans: who appear to be beloved to your husband! anishhTe
glosses.iast: vho appear to be beloved to your husband! aniśhṭe
glosses.devanagari: व्हो अप्पेअर् तो बे बेलोवेद् तो योउर् हुस्बन्द्! अनिश्ह्टे
glosses.meaning: (but) who is not liked by your husband! vikatthase = (you) boast

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी रुष्टया परुषं वचः |
कुब्जया पापदर्शिन्या विषादमगमत्परम्
verses.iast:
evamuktā tu kaikeyī ruśhṭayā paruśhaṃ vacaḥ |
kubjayā pāpadarśinyā viśhādamagamatparam
verses.translation: Kaikeyi was very much worried after hearing hard words spoken with anger by Manthara of sinful thoughts.

verses.devanagari:
कैकेयि त्वब्रवीत्कुभां कच्चित्क्षेमं न मनथरे |
विषण्णवदनां हि त्वां लक्षये भृ शदुःखिताम्
verses.iast:
kaikeyi tvabravītkubhāṃ kaccitkśemaṃ na manathare |
viśhaṇṇavadanāṃ hi tvāṃ lakśaye bhṛ śaduḥkhitām
verses.translation: Kaikeyi asked the hunch-backed Manthara as follows; "O, Manthara! Are you not safe? You appear to be very sorrowful with your worried face".

glosses.meaning: (you are feeling) not safe or what ? lakshaye hi = I am seeing

verses.devanagari:
मन्थरा तु वचः श्रुत्वा कैकेय्या मधुराक्षरम् |
उवाच क्रोधसंयुक्ता वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदा
verses.iast:
mantharā tu vacaḥ śrutvā kaikeyyā madhurākśaram |
uvāca krodhasaṃyuktā vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradā
verses.translation: After hearing Kaikeyi's sweet words, Manthara who was an expert in talking, spoke with anger.

glosses.meaning: who was an expert in talking

verses.devanagari:
सा विषण्णतरा भूत्वा कुब्जा तस्या हितैषिणी |
विषदयन्ती प्रोवाच भेदयन्ती च राघवम्
verses.iast:
sā viśhaṇṇatarā bhūtvā kubjā tasyā hitaiśhiṇī |
viśhadayantī provāca bhedayantī ca rāghavam
verses.translation: That Manthara, who was full of cunning, feigning to be seeking Kaikeyi's welfare, appeared more worried, and making Kaikeyi sorrowful, spoke the following, to create hostility between Rama and Kaikeyi.

verses.devanagari:
अक्षय्यं सुमहद्देवि प्रवृत्तं द्वद्विनाशनम् |
रामं दशरथो राजा यौवराज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
akśayyaṃ sumahaddevi pravṛttaṃ dvadvināśanam |
rāmaṃ daśaratho rājā yauvarājye'bhiśhekśyati
verses.translation: "Oh, queen! An unending great ruin has encircled you. King Dasaratha is going to anoint Rama for the princely kingdom".

verses.devanagari:
सास्म्यगाधे भये मग्ना दुःखशोकसमन्विता |
दह्यमानाऽ नलेनेव त्वद्धितार्थमिहागता
verses.iast:
sāsmyagādhe bhaye magnā duḥkhaśokasamanvitā |
dahyamānā' naleneva tvaddhitārthamihāgatā
verses.translation: "I am immersed in a bottomless pit of fear. I am in distress and my mind is burning as if by fire. I hastened here to seek you out."

verses.devanagari:
तव दुःखेन कैकेयि मम दुःखं महद्भवेत् |
त्वद्वृद्धौ मम वृद्धिश्च भवेदत्र न संशयः
verses.iast:
tava duḥkhena kaikeyi mama duḥkhaṃ mahadbhavet |
tvadvṛddhau mama vṛddhiśca bhavedatra na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "Kaikeyi! If Rama becomes king, his son will become king after him. Thus, Bharata's name itself will be removed from the royal clan."

verses.devanagari:
नराधिपकुले जाता महिषी त्वं महीपतेः |
उग्रत्वं राजधर्माणां कथं देवि न बुध्यसे
verses.iast:
narAdhipakule jAtA mahiṣI tvaṃ mahIpateḥ |
ugratvaṃ rAjadharmAṇAṃ kathaṃ devi na budhyase
verses.translation: "Oh, Kaikeyi! Having born in a royal family and being an emperor's wife, how is it that you are not knowing about the cruelty in kingly duties?"

verses.devanagari:
धर्मवादी शठो भर्ता श्लक्ष्णवादी च दारुणः |
शुद्धभावे न जानीषे तेनैवमतिसन्धिता
verses.iast:
dharmavAdI śaṭho bhartA ślakṣṇavAdI ca dAruṇaḥ |
śuddhabhAve na jAnIṣe tenaivamatisandhitA
verses.translation: "Your husband talks about righteousness, but does harm secretly. He says sweet words but behaves cruelly. Because of your clean thinking; you are not able to know that he is cheating you thus."

glosses.meaning: you are not able to know

verses.devanagari:
उपस्थितं पयुञ्जानस्त्वयि सान्त्वमनर्थकम् |
अर्थेनैवाद्य ते भर्ता कौसल्यां योजयिष्यति
verses.iast:
upasthitaṃ payuñjAnastvayi sAntvamanarthakam |
arthenaivAdya te bhartA kausalyAṃ yojayiṣyati
verses.translation: "Your husband approaches you and talks good words, which are useless. But he passes on benefit today to Kausalya only."

verses.devanagari:
अपवाह्य स दुष्टात्मा भरतं तव बन्धुषु |
काल्यं स्थापयिता रामं राज्ये निहतकण्टके
verses.iast:
apavAhya sa duṣṭAtmA bharataṃ tava bandhuṣu |
kAlyaṃ sthApayitA rAmaṃ rAjye nihatakaṇṭake
verses.translation: "The evil minded Dasaratha sent Bharata to the house of his relatives and at dawn, is going to install Rama on the throne without hindrance."

verses.devanagari:
शत्रुः पतिप्रवादेन मात्रेव हितकाम्यया |
आशीविष इवाङ्केन बाले परिधृतस्त्वया
verses.iast:
śatruḥ patipravAdena mAtreva hitakAmyayA |
AśIviṣa ivAñkena bAle paridhṛtastvayA
verses.translation: "O, childish one! Like a mother, you wish for his well being. But he is an enemy, and is called husband for a namesake. He is like a poisonous serpent in your bosom."

glosses.meaning: like a poisonous serpent in your bosom

verses.devanagari:
यथा हि कुर्यात्सर्पो वा शत्रुर्वा प्रत्युपेक्षितः |
राज्ञा दशरथेनाद्य सपुत्रा त्वं तथा कृता
verses.iast:
yathA hi kuryAtsarpo vA śatrurvA pratyupekṣitaḥ |
rAGYA daśarathenAdya saputrA tvaṃ tathA kṛtA
verses.translation: "King Dasaratha has acted towards you and your son today in the same way as an enemy or a serpent would behave if ignored."

verses.devanagari:
पापेनानृतसान्त्वेन बाले नित्यं सुखोचिते |
रामं स्थापयता राज्ये सानुबन्धा हता ह्यसि
verses.iast:
pApenAnṛtasāntvena bAle nityaṃ sukhocite |
rAmaṃ sthApayatA rAjye sAnubandhA hatA hyasi
verses.translation: "O, stupid one! With his untruthful sweet words to you, who are ever deserving of ease, the evil minded king is installing Rama on the throne and is thus ruining you along with your son."

verses.devanagari:
सा प्राप्तकालं कैकेयि क्षिप्रं कुरु हितं तव |
त्रायस्व पुत्रमात्मानं मां च विस्मयदर्शने
verses.iast:
sA prAptakAlaṃ kaikeyi kṣipraṃ kuru hitaṃ tava |
trAyasva putramAtmAnaṃ mAṃ ca vismayadarśane
verses.translation: "O, Kaikeyi, of amazing beauty! You have to take timely action immediately, so as to save yourself, your son and me too."

verses.devanagari:
मन्थराया वचः श्रुत्वा शयनात्स शुभानना |
उत्तस्थौ हर्षसंपूर्णा चन्द्रलेखेव शारदी
verses.iast:
mantharAyA vacaḥ śrutvA śayanAtsa śubhAnanA |
uttasthau harśhasampūrṇā candralekheva śāradī
verses.translation: Hearing Manthara's words, that Kaikeyi of charming countenance who was lying in bed, rose from her coach full of delight like unto the crescent moon in autumn.

verses.devanagari:
अतीव सा तु संहृष्टाअ कैकेयी विस्मयान्विता |
एकमाभरणं तस्यै कुब्जायै प्रददौ शुभम्
verses.iast:
atīva sā tu saṃhṛśhṭāa kaikeyī vismayānvitā |
ekamābharaṇaṃ tasyai kubjāyai pradadau śubham
verses.translation: That Kaikeyi in the midst of her astonishment and joy gave a graceful jewel to the hunch-backed Manthara.

verses.devanagari:
दत्त्वा त्वाभरणं तस्यै कुब्जायै प्रमदोत्तमा |
कैकेयी मन्थरां हृष्टा पुनरेवाब्रवीदिदम्
verses.iast:
dattvA tvAbharaṇaṃ tasyai kubjAyai pramadottamA |
kaikeyI mantharAṃ hṛṣṭA punarevAbravIdidam
verses.translation: Kaikeyi, the best among women, gave a jewel to Manthara and spoke to her as follows:

verses.devanagari:
इदं तु मन्थरे मह्यमाख्यासि परमं प्रियम् |
एतन्मे प्रियमाख्यातुः किं वा भूयः करोमि ते
verses.iast:
idaṃ tu manthare mahyamAkhyAsi paramaṃ priyam |
etanme priyamAkhyAtuḥ kiṃ vA bhUyaḥ karomi te
verses.translation: "Oh, Manthara! You informed much gladdening news to me. What else can I do for you, who informed such a good news?"

verses.devanagari:
रामे वा भरते वाहं विशेषं नोपलक्षये |
तस्मात्तुष्टास्मि यद्राजा रामं राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
rAme vA bharate vAhaṃ viśeṣaṃ nopalakṣaye |
tasmAttuṣṭAsmi yadrAjA rAmaṃ rAjye'bhiṣekṣyati
verses.translation: "I do not see any difference between Rama and Bharata. That is why, I am happy that Rama is being anointed for crown by the king."

verses.devanagari:
न मे परम् किञ्चि दितस्त्वयापि न |
प्रियं प्रियार्हे सुवचम् वचो परम् |
तथा ह्यवोचस्त्वमतः प्रियोत्तरं |
वरं वरं ते प्रददामि तं वृणु
verses.iast:
na me param kiJṇci ditastvayApi na |
priyaṃ priyArhe suvacam vaco param |
tathA hyavocastvamataḥ priyottaraṃ |
varaṃ varaṃ te pradadAmi taṃ vṛṇu
verses.translation: "O, Manthara! You do merit every favor. I have no other pleasant news than this. Hence, you cannot ever again inform a better loving news than this. I shall give you a good boon. Ask for it!"

glosses.itrans: who are eligible to be delighted! na kinchit
glosses.iast: vho are eligible to be delighted! na kincit
glosses.devanagari: व्हो अरे एलिगिब्ले तो बे देलिघ्तेद्! न किन्चित्
